description.value: The Forest Grove Branch is a small community library operated by the Cariboo Regional District Library, one of 15 branches spread across the vast Cariboo region of BC's Central Interior. It serves the rural Forest Grove community with physical collections, digital borrowing services, and community event programming. For touring cyclists making their way through this sparsely serviced stretch of interior BC, it is one of the few publicly accessible stops along the route.
